title: Isolate failover executor and modernize regional affinity layer
creator: Evan Park
description: Scope: Extract the current fallback orchestration code out of the monolithic PolicyEngine into a standalone FailoverExecutor service and replace the ad-hoc regional affinity tables with a deterministic Affinity Mesh. Goals: 1) Remove lock-heavy critical paths in route selection and reduce tail latency for the smart router hotpath. 2) Make fallback sequencing testable and reusable across hosted/dedicated/private deployments. 3) Provide a clear interface for future circuit-breaker and surge handling integrations. Success metrics: reduce 95th/99th token-latency in routing hotpath by 10%+, reduce longest lock hold times in route-resolution by 40%, and lower fallback-induced concurrency spikes observed in production dashboards. Out of scope: UI console changes and customer-facing rollout controls (these will be separate PM tickets).
